pi.frontmatter:
name: commander
description: >-
  Pi 每轮路由入口：按用户本条要的产物选出至多一个 personal skill（找文件、代码怎么走、
  排查日志、research、短答、解释、交接、分支、commit message 等）。用户规则要求
  commander-first 或用户点名 commander 时加载。判据以本文件产物表为准，不按关键词计分。

cursor.frontmatter:
name: commander
description: >-
  Routes each turn to one personal skill by the artifact the user wants
  (code path, diagnostic logs, log cleanup, research, a segmented answer,
  unpacking a short reply, session handoff, coding handoff, branch merge,
  opening a branch from dev or release, or a one-line commit message).
  Clarifies intent (artifact, depth, evidence,
  format) before routing. Use when User Rules require commander-first
  or the user names commander. Read this file, pick one skill, Read its
  SKILL.md, then act. Does not score keywords.
disable-model-invocation: true
